text:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up — StratusCloud invited Redwood to join their Equinox-East marketplace. They want a published SKU + 30-day soft launch.
Ethan (Partnerships): Great. Do we have requested capacity? any special compliance asks?
Maya (Partnerships): Stratus offered initial entitlement: 12 reserved GPUs, burst to 36 for first 30 days. They require HSM-backed keys or customer KMS. Also need a joint press embargo window.
Ravi (Infra Ops): 12 reserved is doable but will need a specific nodepool in the equinox-east AZ. Estimate: 4 days to provision, 1 day for AMI bake+warm.
Priya (SRE): Agree. Also want latency SLIs for the region pre- and post-launch. Can we get a capacity hold for 48h around launch?
Maya (Partnerships): I'll ask Stratus ops for a 48h capacity hold and confirm.
Ethan (Partnerships): Stratus also needs mapping to their SKU catalog. Draft name they suggested: redwood-inference.east.equinox.v2.
Maya (Partnerships): dropping the suggested mapping they pasted: 
```
SKU: redwood-inference.east.equinox.v2
Plan: reserved-12
Burst: burst-36
KMS: hsm-required
```
Priya (SRE): HSM requirement — Nora, are we good to support partner HSM or do we require customer-managed keys?
Nora (Legal): We can support partner HSM if the contract includes KMS usage terms and key access controls. I'll prepare an HSM appendix and a 3-way DPA (Redwood-Stratus-customer) template. Need Stratus legal contact.
Ravi (Infra Ops): Technically, HSM integration will need network egress rules and an IAM role. I can prototype in staging this week.
Maya (Partnerships): Stratus marketing wants a joint launch cadence: soft launch (limited customers) -> collect metrics 14 days -> public blog. They also requested a one-week embargo before blog.
Ethan (Partnerships): Who owns the canary? Ops or Stratus?
Priya (SRE): We should run our canary against staging SKU, Stratus to mirror traffic routing. Propose 24h canary then ramp.
DeployBot: ticket #PRT-2201 created: "Stratus Equinox-East Marketplace Onramp" assigned to Maya, Ravi, Priya. ETA infra: 4 days.
Maya (Partnerships): Next steps: Maya to get Stratus legal contact + confirm hold; Ravi to open infra PR for nodepool + IAM; Priya to add SLI dashboard + canary runbook; Nora to draft HSM appendix. Sync Wednesday 11:00am ET.
Ravi (Infra Ops): One risk: GPU model type mismatch. I'll request exact SKU family from Stratus ops and flag if we need fallback plans.
Ethan (Partnerships): I'll coordinate partner comms and draft joint announcement timeline.
Nora (Legal): I'll email Stratus legal today and loop in contracts.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks team — will post updates here. :rocket:
